segments.title: Pepito Cold Open: Scrumming Anthem
segments.notes: Executive producer Pepito delivers the broadcast sign-on as a surreal rap about 'scrumming,' veterinary credentials, high-value pennies, and mattress-based lullabies while asserting canine identity.

segments.title: News Block: Iran-Israel Escalation & JD Vance Bit

segments.title: Debate: Soft vs Hard Pretzels; Crum's Gorilla Debt Climax

segments.title: Rob Elvie Intervention: Failed Apology & Instant Re-Banning

segments.title: News Roundup: Morgan Whalen Country Music Ads & Headlines

segments.title: Song Production: 'Line Dancing at the Opera Tonight' ft. San Antonio Domingo
segments.notes: DJ C4 (ghost, claims nepotism relation to Case) speed-runs operatic country line-dancing track with French-Italian vocalist San Antonio Domingo; lyrics blend Chevy trucks, porta-potties, Andrea Bocelli, mother-in-law fat jokes, Yo-Yo Ma confusion, Phantom of the Opera; Domingo nails three takes in 30 minutes; DJ C4 raids Kendall.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opens with Pepito's surreal canine rap before Case and Kendall debate genital-holding etiquette; the news block descends into JD Vance impressions and penis-holding hypotheticals while covering Iran's missile retaliation against Israel; Crum faces match point in the Crum Dick Punch saga needing two debate wins to avoid gorilla execution; Rob Elvie's apology attempt collapses into instant re-banning; the broadcast closes with DJ C4's frantic 30-minute production of an operatic country line-dancing track featuring the French-Italian vocalist San Antonio Domingo, culminating in a raid on Kendall's channel.
